hypothesis: A deterministic medoid of the last four strictly past assigned native identity embeddings could suppress a noisy history observation without changing the proposal graph, appearance weight, geometry, lifecycle or encoder.
selection_guard: Rule fixed before evaluation; no threshold, seed, video or outer metric selected. One SN-015 outer probe is a gate, not a claim of all-video generalization.

scope.features: frozen DINO K4 native current-only bank
scope.memory: medoid of last four observed native identity embeddings

interpretation: The fixed medoid worsens HOTA by 1.7905 points and IDF1 by 3.9848 points while adding one ID switch versus the paired frozen FIFO replay. This rejects the medoid-memory hypothesis for expansion; it does not support a project-wide NO_GO or a positive contribution claim.
next_boundary: Do not tune medoid distance, history length or thresholds from this outer result. Any further exploration must use a distinct independently motivated signal and fit-only selection.
